about.title: About
about.label: About
about.blurb: A short portrait of Brigitte — her practice, her studio, and the signatures she has worked under.
about.bio: Brigitte Roshay has painted and sculpted for more than thirty years. Trained in classical drawing and self-taught in clay, she works out of a small studio in France — between long walks along the lake and quiet mornings at the window. Her landscapes and interiors are painted from memory; her figures, in terracotta and bronze, are pulled from the same patient attention.
about.quote: “Art is perception — born where imagination meets the soul.”
